holdout_access_scan.detail: AST scan: the fit tool uses none of the forbidden holdout loader symbols, imports no validation/holdout module and declares no validation/holdout data path

hyperparameters.exact_weight: w_exact = n0 / (n0 + kappa0), non-decreasing in n0
hyperparameters.recursion: resolved bottom-up from L4; L4 prior is the base Dirichlet; a parent is only entered when the child level is below threshold

no_pseudo_observation.detail: each observation is a parsed certified TRAIN non-Hero preflop decision row whose public whitelist, exact key and level keys are recomputed and re-validated

base_prior.rationale: weak uniform prior so sparse cells stay wide instead of collapsing to zero

constraints: a parent never adds support observations to the requested key
no cross-level smoothing of the support counts themselves
priors_and_shrinkage.exact_weight: w_exact = n0 / (n0 + kappa0), non-decreasing in n0
priors_and_shrinkage.kappa0_continuity: kappa0=16 toward the same support_context_key marginal reproduces the #352/#388 prospective_shrinkage rule; here that parent is the explicit level L3_RUNTIME_SUPPORT_CONTEXT

raise_frontier_diagnostics.purpose: evidence-only counterfactual: the same frozen estimator with the #388 structural raise frontier removed. It is NOT the candidate and admits nothing.

raise_sizing_policy.declaration_scope: per requested exact key: any other exact key at the same structural frontier independently fails closed when its own observations expose no exact raise target
forbidden: target drift or interpolation between observed sizings
pruning an unresolved frontier as zero mass
raise_sizing_policy.supported_targets: only target_total_bb values empirically present at the exact structural node, emitted by the #367 exact-reference translator
raise_sizing_policy.unresolved_frontier_behaviour: the branch and its required descendants remain explicitly unresolved; reason code EXACT_UNRESOLVED; the tree is not claimed complete

seeds.purpose: the frozen estimator is a closed-form Dirichlet shrinkage; the recorded seed only pins observation ordering and tie-breaking, no sampling is performed

support_isolation.detail: each observation carries exactly one hierarchical_exact_key and joins only the support bucket of that key; parents are used for parameters only
